D.t: Emilia Sykes leads by 24.3 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 77,117 votes; a one point swing is about 1,586 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +15.3 and D +33.4. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
